mapper.sql:
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN loyalty_accounts la ON la.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN reward_rules rr ON rr.id = coalesce(la.reward_rule_id, (SELECT id FROM reward_rules WHERE active)) WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.marketing_opt_out_at IS NULL AND c.phone_enc IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.customer_id = c.id AND s.branch_id = #{a.branchId} AND s.status = 'CONFIRMED')
AND coalesce(c.last_visit_at, c.registered_at) < #{a.inactiveSince}
AND la.current_stamps > 0 AND la.current_stamps < rr.stamps_required AND la.current_stamps >= rr.stamps_required - 2
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rewards w WHERE w.customer_id = c.id AND w.status = 'AVAILABLE')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE id = #{branchId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaigns (id, text, audience, inactive_days, branch_id, recipients, segments_per_message, total_sms, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{text}, #{audience}, #{inactiveDays}, #{branchId}, #{recipients}, #{segmentsPerMessage}, #{totalSms}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO campaign_recipients (campaign_id, customer_id, status) SELECT #{campaignId}, c.id, 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE campaigns SET recipients = #{recipients}, total_sms = #{totalSms} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT id, text, audience, inactive_days, branch_id, recipients, segments_per_message, total_sms, status, reject_reason, created_by, created_at, decided_at, sent_count, failed_count, finished_at FROM campaigns
mapper.select: ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE campaigns SET status = #{to}, decided_at = coalesce(#{decidedAt}, decided_at), decided_by = coalesce(#{decidedBy}, decided_by), reject_reason = coalesce(#{rejectReason}, reject_reason) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM campaigns WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'SENDING') ORDER BY decided_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_recipients r SET status = 'SKIPPED' FROM customers c WHERE r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND c.id = r.customer_id AND (c.status <> 'ACTIVE' OR c.marketing_opt_out_at IS NOT NULL OR c.phone_enc IS NULL)
UPDATE campaign_recipients SET status = 'FAILED', sent_at = #{now}, error = 'Göndəriş yarımçıq qaldı' WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'SENDING' AND claimed_at < #{claimedBefore}
mapper.select: UPDATE campaign_recipients r SET status = 'SENDING', claimed_at = #{now} FROM customers c WHERE c.id = r.customer_id AND (r.campaign_id, r.customer_id) IN ( SELECT campaign_id, customer_id FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING r.customer_id, c.phone_enc
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_recipients SET status = #{status}, sent_at = #{now}, error = #{error} WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND customer_id = #{customerId}

UPDATE campaigns c SET status = 'SENT', finished_at = #{now}, sent_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = c.id AND status = 'SENT'), failed_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = c.id AND status = 'FAILED') WHERE c.id = #{campaignId} AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'SENDING') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = c.id AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING'))
